runHistory.summary: Offline-first storage infrastructure implemented with AsyncStorage, Zustand store, and TypeScript models
notes: React Native project initialized with TypeScript template
AsyncStorage installed for local data persistence
Zustand installed for state management with persistence middleware
Data models: Session, Streak, UserPreferences, WeeklyProgress, Statistics
Storage layer provides CRUD operations with error handling
All error messages are in Turkish as per product requirements
TypeScript type checking passes with no errors
